issues.description: Problem statement for Aufgabe 01 requests the names and Internet addresses (url) of all zoos and the name and regierungsbezirk of the respective Gemeinde, but the provided solution only selects Zoo.name and Zoo.url (Internetadresse) and omits Gemeinde.name and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. The template query also does not include the zoo url or the Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk and lacks the join condition. This mismatch between problem statement, template, and solution will confuse students about the expected output columns and the correct final query.
issues.suggestedFix: Align template and solution with the problem statement. Update template/solution SELECT to include the requested Gemeinde columns and ensure the join condition is present. For example: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url AS Internetadresse, Gemeinde.name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo, Gemeinde WHERE Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel. Alternatively, if the solution's output is intended, update the problem statement to match the columns actually returned by the solution.
